FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How much does a move cost?

Our rates depend on distance, volume, number of floors and date. The equipped truck, fuel, mileage and insurance are included. Request a free quote: we reply quickly.

Do you cover all of Quebec?

Yes. We serve Greater Montreal every day (island of Montreal, Laval, North Shore, South Shore) and deliver anywhere in Quebec, scheduled or next day.

Do you offer free quotes?

Absolutely. Fill out the request form or call us at 514-424-7936: quotes are free, with no obligation.

Do you deliver on weekends and holidays?

Yes, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for urgent delivery. And moving is done on weekends.

Do you unload containers?

Yes: loading and unloading of 20- and 40-foot containers, palletizing and sorting, in Montreal, Laval and on both shores, even on weekends.

What can we do for you?

Free quote, fast reply, 7 days a week.
